data.title: Engineering Design Review
data.subtitle: Decision memo for a robust validation workflow
data.author: Systems Team
data.executiveSummary: Adopt a reproducible verification loop that connects requirements, test cases, observations, and defensible engineering decisions.

sections.heading: Context
sections.body: A successful build alone does not establish system quality. The workflow must preserve the relationship between test configuration, input stimuli and observed behavior.

sections.heading: Recommended approach
sections.body: Use an incremental experiment plan, maintain raw evidence and compare at least two plausible hypotheses before locking the implementation.
bullets: Keep an auditable log of every run.

sections.heading: Acceptance criteria
sections.body: Accept the design when functional checks pass, unresolved limitations are explicitly recorded and a second engineer can reproduce the result.
